opportunities.title: Junior Scientist Conference Grant

amount.raw: Scheme A up to £200; Scheme B up to £500 (up to £750 for Adelphi Genetics Forum co-sponsored awards); Scheme C up to £300

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Genetics Society junior scientist members. Scheme A: undergraduate, Master's, PhD student and postdoctoral members within six years of PhD viva. Schemes B & C: PhD students and postdocs within six years of viva. UK-based members for overseas conferences and non-UK members for UK conferences. Applicants must present a poster or give a talk. Supervisors must be Society members.
opportunities.summary: Supports attendance of Genetics Society junior scientist members at genetics research conferences. Three streams: (A) Genetics Society/SIG meetings, (B) non-Society meetings, (C) virtual conferences.

opportunities.title: Training Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All Genetics Society members studying or working in the UK, or attending a course held in the UK. Students can apply as soon as they become members; others should be members for at least one year. Supervisors must be Society members.
opportunities.summary: Grants to enable members to attend formal short training courses, or a collaborative visit to another laboratory to train in specific genetic/genomic techniques.

opportunities.title: Heredity Fieldwork Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All Genetics Society members studying or working in the UK, or intending to carry out fieldwork in the UK. Students can apply as soon as they become members; others should be members for at least one year. Supervisors must be Society members.
opportunities.summary: Awards to cover travel and accommodation costs associated with field-based genetic research projects, funded by income from the journal Heredity. Research should be suitable for publication in Heredity.

opportunities.title: Carer's Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any Genetics Society member can apply, regardless of age of the person they are caring for. Priority given to early-career scientists and according to need.
opportunities.summary: Award to support attendance at a Society meeting for members with caring responsibilities, usable as the awardee thinks best supports their attendance.

opportunities.title: One-off Meeting Grant

amount.raw: From a few hundred pounds for a lecture to up to about £1,000 for a session; major sponsorship of an entire meeting several thousand pounds (last 12 months £1,000-£2,000)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to Genetics Society members. Meetings should be based in, or have strong links with, the UK.
opportunities.summary: Sponsorship of genetic-themed meetings not organised directly by the Genetics Society, towards the organisation of a meeting (not attendance).

opportunities.title: Public Engagement Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to members of the Genetics Society.
opportunities.summary: Support for public engagement activities related to genetics, delivered in person or virtually, covering eligible travel and materials costs.

opportunities.title: Special Interest Group Funding
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to genetics research communities wishing to run regular series of meetings. Meetings should be based in, or have strong links with, the UK.
opportunities.summary: Sponsorship of research meetings on particular themes for genetics research communities wishing to run regular series of meetings.
